items.title: File Widerspruch against contribution increase
items.quote: Den Widerspruch können Sie binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Musterquell Krankenkasse, Am Brunnenhof 2, 35390 Mustergießen.
items.computation: Letter dated (and posted) 18.11.2026 by a statutory health insurer (Krankenkasse, social-law body under SGB X). Delivery fiction: posting day + 4 calendar days = 18.11.2026 + 4 = 22.11.2026 (a Sunday). For social-law bodies (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X), unlike tax offices, the deemed delivery day does NOT move even if it falls on a weekend/holiday, so Bekanntgabe = 22.11.2026. One-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG / § 26 SGB X counting rules, §§ 187, 188 BGB): the day of delivery is not counted, period starts 23.11.2026 and ends one month later on the day with the same number, i.e. 22.12.2026. 22.12.2026 is a Tuesday (not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NW), so no end-of-period shift is needed (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X).
